prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a premium fantasy naval game's world-space mountain panorama, not a scene screenshot. Create a very wide 3:1 landscape cutout, continuous terrain stretching completely from the left edge to the right edge. Straight front elevation, no perspective framing. True transparent alpha above the jagged skyline only; the entire bottom half must be solid opaque land reaching the image bottom, no transparent gaps anywhere below the skyline. No ocean, water, sky, moon, clouds, buildings, ships, words or borders. Crisp realistic high-detail painted 3D matte-painting, not cartoon, not neon, no blurry haze. Seamless matching terrain height/color at the left and right edges so it can wrap around a circular landscape. Palette deep midnight blue, slate blue rock, pale icy highlights, subdued gold and violet accents under elegant celestial moonlight. Subject: continuous monumental distant alpine ridgeline, many varied sharp peaks, layered snowy stone ridges; a broad low rocky ridge connects all peaks. Fill most of the canvas with opaque mountain terrain. Peak heights vary organically, no isolated island silhouette.
